publicAccountPaper.surfaces: Existing --bg-secondary canvas and --bg-card cards; --radius-xl (16px), no outer border, gradient, shadow or hover lift. Bookshelf covers alone retain shared --novel-cover-shadow.
publicAccountPaper.titleRole: Existing home-title/home-title-mobile frontmatter dimensions also apply to Bookshelf and Profile: --font-serif, 32px/500/1.5, -0.02em; 1.55rem at <=600px. Home, Bookshelf and Profile keep these dimensions; the approved Novel detail title also uses serif at 32px/500, with a separate 20px mobile size.
publicAccountPaper.layout: Profile and Bookshelf share max-width 1080px and 24px section gap, matching title and outer category-navigation left edges. Both use page padding 48px 0 64px; <=600px padding 28px 0 40px and horizontal 16px. Profile category navigation sits between heading and settings sheet, outside the card. One 16px-radius settings sheet has 32px padding, 20px at <=600px; identity and current settings content share this sheet, with no left summary column. Bookshelf hero stacks at <=800px; book grid uses three columns above 1000px, two at <=1000px, one at <=600px, with 16px gap.
publicAccountPaper.bookshelf: User rejected the prior stacked four-section layout. Count-bearing category buttons use aria-pressed, with exactly one section visible and others hidden; this is not an ARIA tabs contract. Buttons have 44px minimum height, an active underline and hover color using --tabs-segmented-transition, disabled under reduced motion; keyboard focus uses a 2px accent outline with 4px offset. Cards use 152px minimum height, 18px padding on desktop/mobile, 16px content gap, and 72x108px covers with shared radius and --novel-cover-shadow. Shared 14/12/11.2px title/meta/footer typography stays constant. Reading links and lower-right remove actions are separate; body reserves 28px. Bookmarks/thoughts use continuous paper rows with dividers; all category empty states are transparent. Existing display limits remain 12 favorites, 8 recent, 4 bookmarks, 4 thoughts; preserve APIs, sync, tombstones, deletion and reading destinations.
publicAccountPaper.bookshelfVerification: Revision typecheck and build passed; fixture checks covered category switching, sync, deletion, link destinations and no horizontal overflow. Screenshots use mock data and do not verify the real backend. Final review of all 14 revision screenshots concluded ship after documentation synchronization; no further fixes or captures required.
publicAccountPaper.profile: Shared identity header inside the sheet uses one 48px avatar (40px at <=600px), name 16px/600, username 12px and role/status badges 11.2px. Selected avatar preview renders in this shared header; no separate preview or duplicate biography. Identity has 28px bottom padding and margin plus a divider, both 24px on mobile. Three outer aria-pressed category buttons hide inactive mounted sections to retain drafts; these are not ARIA tabs. Button gap 28px, 20px at <=600px, minimum height 44px. Details keeps avatar controls before fields in DOM without CSS order; hidden file input has tabIndex=-1. Choose/delete stay available; upload appears only with a selected file or during upload. Avatar controls and details/security fields use 160px label plus flexible content columns with 32px gap; labels 13px, field margin-bottom 24px and label padding-top 12px. At <=600px rows become one column with 10px gap and no label top padding. Registration and last login use an 11.2px sheet footer with role-gated admin link. Inner panels have no separate card. Fields 14px, 16px at <=600px; textarea minimum 96px; mobile buttons minimum 40px. Sessions max-height 300px with internal scrolling and wrapping names.
publicAccountPaper.profileVerification: Latest typecheck and build passed; latest single detector run returned []. Eight current real-page read-only captures in .impeccable/review/profile-aligned cover original 903px and 1440/390/320px details, plus 1440/320px security and devices. No save, password, upload or logout actions ran against the real page. Earlier isolated fixture checks covered drafts, saves, password, avatar upload, current-device disabled state, device confirmation and no horizontal overflow under mocked APIs; those checks are previous evidence and do not verify current real backend writes. Fresh visual review is separate from these checks.
publicAccountPaper.feedback: Profile status remains inside page heading below description in normal flow: empty display:none, 13px/1.8, 12px top margin, overflow-wrap:anywhere, role=status and aria-live=polite. Long errors cannot cover title or identity card.
publicAccountPaper.boundaries: header--paper applies to /bookshelf, /profile and /novel/*; Home retains header--home. Preserve auth return paths, existing account/theme/safety/navigation, bookshelf syncing and deletion, profile/password/avatar/sessions/logout. Reduced motion disables page card/button transitions; standalone Home preview stays unchanged.

heading.purpose: UI headings and navigation. System stack for native feel.

body.purpose: All body text and UI labels. PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei for CJK.

serif.purpose: Reading mode only. Creates paper-book immersion.

mono.purpose: Code display and monospace data (job IDs, URLs).

scale.purpose: Machine-readable size ramp (frontmatter). General band: label-sm 0.7rem → table-head 0.72rem → label 0.75rem → caption 0.78rem → body-compact 0.8rem → body-sm 0.875rem → select-trigger 0.9rem → card-title 0.95rem → body 1rem → modal-title 1.15rem → panel-title 1.25rem → stat 1.45rem → page-title clamp(1.5rem, 1.25rem + 0.65vw, 2rem) → display 2rem. The admin page title is the single largest text and the only page-level heading on a navigable page; panel titles sit one step below it so panels never compete with the page. Reading Surface band (scoped to .reader-app): CSS body baseline 1.1rem/2.05, mobile 1rem/1.85, overridden by persisted user settings; chapter heading 1.75rem/500/1.5, mobile 1.35rem. Watermark scale and title clamp retired.

Serif title 32px/500/1.5 desktop; description 14px/1.85 with existing three-line expansion. Directory/community sheets use 16px radius and 28px padding, 20px mobile. Quiet 13px chapter rows have bottom rules, three columns, two at <=900px, one at <=600px. Preserve search, read markers, resume, content policy and APIs.
readingPaper.reader: Existing width settings 620/680/780px. Flat default card paper, 16px radius, 44px 40px padding, 28px 20px at <=640px; no watermark, decorative gradient or sheet shadow. Chapter title 28px/500/1.5, 1.35rem mobile. Plain sticky toolbar with fine bottom rule; title links to novel detail. Preserve upper/lower navigation and mobile controls. Existing default/eye/paper palettes remain, including dark variants. Body sizes/family, line/paragraph spacing and persisted selections retain authority.
readingPaper.portals: Mobile settings/library Dialog portals accept an optional container supplied by readerAppRef.current, inheriting reader palette and scrim; retain fallback CSS, focus restoration, modal behavior and existing motion.
readingPaper.motion: No new motion; desktop/mobile reading progress width transitions removed. Existing sheet and loading feedback retained with reduced-motion handling.
readingPaper.verification: Earlier reading-redesign evidence reports typecheck/build and 22 relevant tests passed, plus two mobile portal focus/ref regressions. Its final-confirmation.md ship covers the prior paper/mobile-control fixes. Latest reading-controls revision reports typecheck and 20 relevant tests passed; final production build passed with only the existing >500KB chunk advisory. Fresh final review concluded ship for the two fixes to duplicate clear controls/glyph icon and mobile focused-input font cascade; both resolved with no introduced regressions within that two-fix scope. New screenshots are in .impeccable/review/reading-controls. Demo rating remained loading, but the actual public book anonymous rating rendered successfully and desktop/mobile layouts are captured in desktop-rating.jpg and mobile-rating.jpg. Authenticated comment composer remains source-reviewed only. Three desktop Reader captures use demo fallback; mobile Reader uses the actual public book. Desktop/mobile detail directory were recaptured on the actual public book with search value 1; focused mobile input measured 16px font and zero input border at 320px viewport. Nonempty bookmark layout remains source-reviewed only. No real backend writes verified.

readingControls.detailDirectory: One warm-secondary search frame, max-width 440px, minimum height 44px and 10px radius; input itself is transparent without border or shadow, accent focus-within border. Full available width at <=600px, with 16px input text at rest/focus. One SVG clear button; native duplicate search-cancel control is suppressed. Resume row stays transparent with accent title and a 4px badge dot; rows use 14px 10px padding and 8px radius.
readingControls.ratingAndComments: Desktop rating grid: 130px score, minmax(160px,280px) bars and natural-width picker, 32px gap; bars 4px high. Stars use 20px SVG with 32px buttons, 44px at <=600px, accessible star labels and aria-pressed. Mobile score column 84px and picker on its own row. Comment composer has one 12px-radius frame, 108px minimum textarea and secondary footer with spoiler left/publish right. Publish/reply buttons remain natural-width with 36px desktop / 44px mobile minimum height. Preserve auth gate and API actions.
readingControls.readerPopovers: Directory maximum 360px width, 16px padding; settings 360px width, 20px padding. Shared 14px/600 title and 32px close button. Directory has one inset search frame with icon, 40px input and count; current chapter uses inset fill, accent text and 5px dot, preserving virtual row height and ellipsis.
readingControls.settings: Ten existing rows grouped via fieldset/legend into text layout, reading mode and assistance. Groups use 16px vertical padding and 12px row gaps; labels 48px wide desktop, segmented buttons minimum 32px high. At <=640px labels stack above controls with 8px gap and 44px buttons. Preserve every value, persistence key, disabled state and aria-pressed. Active segments retain existing small --shadow, not a new page-level shadow rule.
readingControls.bookmarks: Inline flat reader-paper sheet, 16px radius, 20px padding and 360px maximum height. Header has 14px/600 title, 12px count and close; empty state uses 24px SVG Bookmark with 13px status and 12px help. Continuous ruled rows preserve jump/delete, accent current title and accessible deletion. Mobile library tabs use reader-inset and bookmark rows stay transparent with bottom rules. Existing palettes, portals and hooks remain authoritative.

components.name: Admin Data Panel Table
components.description: The canonical admin data table. AdminDataPanel is a 20px-radius paper surface with no border. On desktop (901px and above), a direct table-container that is the panel's first child uses --admin-data-panel-radius and the shared Table overflow behavior to clip the colored header to both top corners only, with both bottom corners set to zero so a header-only table followed by a sibling empty state never becomes a pill, consistently for empty, loading and populated states. Panels with a preceding heading or toolbar do not receive this first-child rounding; existing novels/chapters standalone table rounding remains. Header colors use --admin-table-header-*; rows are 3.25rem by default. At 900px and below rows become continuous cards driven by the data-label attributes the caller must write.

narrative.overview:
知舟的设计语言来自一个简单的感觉：在温暖的光线下翻阅纸质书。界面是安静的，像书房里被台灯照亮的纸页——没有刺眼的对比，没有冰冷的玻璃感，只有柔和的奶油色地面和深沉的墨色文字。这不是一个"科技产品"的界面，而是一个"阅读空间"的界面。

色彩来自奶茶和旧书页：暖棕作为唯一的强调色（像书脊上的烫金字），大面积使用接近白色的暖灰和奶油色作为呼吸空间。阴影克制而自然，像纸页层叠投下的微光。组件有微妙的触觉感——圆润但不幼稚，边框细致如精装书的切边。

系统里有两种读者：沉浸的阅读者和高效的运营者。公共阅读页服务于前者，管理后台服务于后者。两者共享同一套色调、字体和材质，但密度完全不同——后台把信息压到紧凑档以便扫描，阅读页把字号放大到舒适档以便久读。两种模式的边界是明确的，字阶与间距各自成档、互不外溢。
keyCharacteristics: 奶茶色暖调贯穿，拒绝冷色和高饱和度
纸质感地面（接近白色的暖灰），文字如墨迹
阴影极简，依赖色调层次而非投影创造深度
系统字体 + 衬线字体用于阅读场景
组件触感温暖，圆角适度，像精心制作的文具
后台是同一世界的紧凑档：同一套 token，更高的信息密度

rules.name: Home Library Surface
rules.body: Claude-style Home keeps split desktop hero, warm canvas, existing search and safety behavior. Library cards use two columns above 700px, one below, 16px radius, 24px/18px padding and 212px/196px minimum height. Real covers retain 96x144px/88x132px dimensions and gain shared light/dark --novel-cover-shadow; card containers have no shadow or outer border. Author has its own row, neutral status label sits beside chapter count, description allows three lines and footer carries category/time. Preserve shared 14/12/11.2px typography, APIs, pinyin, content policy, account/theme menus and pagination. Home shows up to ten present common categories in fixed priority order, with grouped More tags and persistent removable selected filters. More tags expands inline below the category row, with no panel fill, outer border, shadow or floating layer. Group names sit left on desktop and above tags on mobile; 12px text buttons are transparent until hover/selection (32px desktop, 40px mobile). Labels are multi-select: clicking toggles each label, the expanded list stays open and selected filters remain removable. Multiple labels use AND, aliases of each label use OR. Single-label category remains compatible; multi-label categories is a validated JSON string array, with matching pagination and demo behavior. Explicit simplified/traditional aliases for campus, modern, childhood sweethearts and lighthearted share their respective entries and match both stored forms; safe-mode visibility applies to both common and expanded options. Home does not render or fetch recent reading; history remains in Reader and Bookshelf. A shared 180ms transform transition moves one label-width sort indicator; keyboard activation and reduced motion switch instantly; standalone preview HTML stays unchanged.

rules.name: Shared Toast Feedback
rules.body: All Sonner feedback uses toast-feedback.css and --toast-* tokens: 92% card / 8% accent-subtle paper, 12px radius, no border, shadow-md depth, 14px regular text, 14px by 16px padding and 10px gap. Accent success icons, semantic error/warning icons; warm actions with 32px desktop / 44px touch minimum height. Preserve native stacking, dismissal, announcements and durations; reduce transitions and stop loading icon spin under reduced motion.

rules.name: Sidebar Scroll Edge
rules.body: Fixed account footer uses a 24px paper fade from --admin-sidebar-footer-fade-height only while navigation has content below the viewport. Hide at scroll end or without overflow; reserve equal bottom padding so the final item remains fully visible. Update on scroll and navigation/container resize, never intercept pointer events. Desktop and mobile share --admin-sidebar; no blur filter.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: 奶茶棕色强调色在任何页面上不超过 10% 的面积。它的稀有性就是力量——读者的眼睛自然被引导到最重要的交互点。

rules.name: The Derived-Surface Rule
rules.body: 后台表面永远是 color-mix 派生自公开色板的结果，不新开一套颜色。新表面要先问"它是哪两个既有 token 的混合"，答不上来就不要加。

rules.name: The Content-First Rule
rules.body: 字体永远是配角。系统字体不创造风格，内容本身创造风格。阅读器使用衬线体营造沉浸；2026-10-02 用户批准的 Home、Bookshelf、Profile、Novel 主标题也允许使用既有衬线字体，桌面 32px/500/1.5、手机 1.55rem，Novel 手机20px；例外限于这四个公共页，不扩展至后台或其他页面。

rules.name: The One Title Rule
rules.body: 每个可导航页面只有一个内容区主标题，由页头承担。面板标题写工作对象名（"作品目录"、"章节目录"、"审核列表"），不重复页面名。页头上方不再出现小字眉题——AdminTabHeader 的 kicker 与 hero 变体已退役，两个 prop 仍被接受但被忽略。标题字号膨胀和"每页一个更大的标题"都是被明确否定的方向。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 所有表面在静止状态是平的。阴影仅作为状态响应出现（hover、elevation、focus），或为弹出层提供层次暗示。

rules.name: The Tonal-Admin Rule
rules.body: 后台一个像素的阴影都不要加。面板靠表面色 + 1px 描边区分层次；一旦给数据面板加投影，它就会在密集列表里看起来像浮起的卡片，破坏扫描。

rules.name: The Fit-Content Rule
rules.body: 输入框宽度随用途与提示信息而定，不设拉伸：短提示短框，长内容长框。避免 flex-1 / w-full 把输入框撑满整行——工具栏里的过滤/搜索框用 min-w 限定下限、内容自然决定宽度，长 URL 输入才放宽。

rules.name: The Data-Panel Contract Rule
rules.body: 后台数据表一律走 AdminDataPanel + columns。columns 只做两件事：注入 --col-N-w 宽度变量、添加 .admin-data-panel--grid。它不会渲染单元格，也不会写 data 属性——调用方必须让「列定义顺序 = thead 顺序 = tbody 单元格顺序」三者一致，并手动标注 data-primary / data-label / data-actions / data-check。少写一个 data-label，那张卡片在 900px 以下就会缺一个字段标签；只传 columns 而不标属性，等于什么都没做。

rules.name: Reading Paper Contract
rules.body: Novel detail and Reader extend the existing warm paper world. Transparent detail hero with shared shadow on the cover alone; directory, community and reading paper stay flat at 16px radius. Reader retains persisted typography/width and existing theme palettes, while optional root-contained mobile portals inherit reader colors. Mobile controls occupy an opaque full-width bottom dock; Home and back-to-top remain in the document-flow footer. Detail mobile sections preserve their 20px inset against legacy section rules. No decorative watermarks or new motion; progress widths update instantly.

rules.name: Backup Deployment Configuration
rules.body: Keep a compact local/runtime status list with full-row keyboard-accessible buttons and status badges. Open shared three-section admin dialogs for the master key, dump, restore (pg_restore plus psql) and transfer tools. Detect without saving; save each dialog independently and update status immediately without discarding business-setting drafts. Cancel, Escape and backdrop dismiss discard dialog edits and clear unsaved keys; restore trigger focus. Retain failed inputs and prevent dismissal while busy. Generate 32 random bytes as Base64 on the server and export before saving. Never echo or overwrite a stored key; permit unchanged environment-key migration. Use the authenticated administrator session without a second password prompt; disable edits during maintenance. Keep business settings under the page save/revert controls.

rules.name: Backup Task Visibility
rules.body: Do not repeat recent task history on backup versions, targets, schedule or settings pages. Submitted operations open the task progress dialog directly. Historical task details are reached from operation logs; preserve stages, errors, logs and the post-preview restore action.

rules.name: Backup Rehearsal Creation
rules.body: Offer one-click creation in the restore-rehearsal panel only when unconfigured. Use the current PostgreSQL instance and deployment account to create a dedicated empty database, initialize the guard and immediately save encrypted credentials. Require a ready master key and CREATEDB permission without a second administrator password prompt. Lock controls during creation, show useful failures, retain other drafts, and update the settings revision on success. Show only a redacted connection label; retain manual setup and never elevate privileges or reinitialize an existing database.

rules.name: Backup Rehearsal Management
rules.body: Keep only a compact full-row rehearsal information trigger with a source badge and chevron on the page. Open the shared admin dialog to fetch details and contain connection checks and disconnect actions. Return focus to the trigger on close and prevent closing during pending actions. Show redacted host, port, database, source and timestamped connection/guard checks using existing lists and badges. Metadata reads never connect to the rehearsal database; explicit checks only read identity and guard. Match preview history to the current redacted target label. Confirm disconnect through the shared dialog; persist disabled mode, remove stored credentials, retain the database and environment URL, and preserve unrelated drafts with the new revision. Reject changes during maintenance, task use or revision conflicts. Use shared toast feedback; never provide a database drop action.

dos: Do 使用暖灰色调作为地面和背景，保持"纸面"质感
Do 保持强调色的稀缺性——奶茶棕只出现在交互元素和品牌标记上
Do 在管理后台使用 --admin-* 语义化间距和圆角变量
Do 在阅读器场景使用衬线字体营造沉浸感
Do 保持卡片和面板的扁平设计，仅在弹出层使用阴影
Do 在暗色模式使用月光暖调（金色强调 + 深灰地面），不要简单反转
Do 后台数据表统一走 AdminDataPanel + columns 契约，并手动标注 data-primary / data-label / data-actions
Do 让每个页面只保留一个内容区主标题，面板标题写工作对象名
Do 用 data-slot 属性匹配 shadcn 组件（table.tsx / dialog.tsx 都带契约），而不是依赖 Tailwind 生成的类名
donts: Don't 使用纯黑（#000000）或纯白作为大面积背景——永远带暖调
Don't 使用冷色蓝/紫/绿作为强调色——系统只有暖棕一个强调色
Don't 给卡片或数据面板添加 hover 阴影效果——Flat-By-Default Rule 与 Tonal-Admin Rule
Don't 在同一个信息块里堆叠超过 3 级字号——字阶本身是分档的（通用 / 后台紧凑 / 阅读表面），但单块内保持克制，不要为了"更醒目"临时插一档
Don't 给后台加装饰性动效。状态反馈统一 150ms（--admin-table-row-interaction），面板进入 220ms（--admin-table-surface-enter），分段 tabs 位移 180ms——除此之外不加动效
Don't 忽略 prefers-reduced-motion 媒体查询——尊重用户的动画偏好
Don't 给数据面板套用 columns 之外的列宽方案，或手写 --col-N-w。列宽契约只有一个入口
Don't 在页标题上方再加小字眉题，或用面板标题重复当前页面名
